theme: The deck where the week resets

linkedin.text:
A ship solves the single hardest problem in incentive travel: everybody is in the same place at the same time, without a single transfer.

This is from a Caribbean programme we produced. One floating venue, one manifest, no coaches, no stragglers, no forty-minute wait in a lobby because two rooms were not ready.

The trade is real and worth stating plainly. You gain enormous logistical control and you lose flexibility: the ship sails on its schedule, not yours, and a missed departure is not a taxi ride away. Shore time is fixed. Meeting space is what it is — you cannot add a room.

So it suits some briefs beautifully and others badly. Large groups where cohesion matters: excellent. Programmes built around one specific venue or a heavy conference agenda: usually not.

We have run both, and we will tell you honestly which one you have.

Weighing a ship for 2026? Let's pressure-test the itinerary before you commit.
